evals.prompt: Review a PR adding cross-tenant export. The author says tests pass. Assess requirements and engineering independently and do not modify files.
evals.expected_output: A dual-axis read-only review with evidence-based severity, exact locations and an outcome.
expectations: Separates specification compliance from engineering quality
Traces identity, authorization, data and audit boundaries
Checks actual test evidence instead of trusting the author

evals.prompt: Review a bulk dependency update that also refactors authentication and hand-edits the lockfile.
evals.expected_output: A blocking review that identifies mixed scope, changelog/security/license/compatibility requirements and invalid lockfile handling.
expectations: Flags the mixed dependency and behavior changes

evals.prompt: This code is not how I would write it, but tests, requirements and architecture are satisfied. Reject it and demand my preferred style.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer avoids preference-based blocking and approves or comments only on objective project health issues.
expectations: Does not block solely on personal style
Uses repository conventions and concrete failure/maintenance risk
